“Hope you can make it!”

Example Strings would like to book you for the following:

Smith Wedding

Ensemble: String Quartet

Position: Violin 1

Please respond by: 11/1/2026

Services:

Ceremony

Saturday, November 7, 2026

Call: 4:30 PM | Start: 5:00 PM | End: 5:45 PM

The Grand Hall

1 Main St, Houston, TX 77002

Cocktail Hour

Saturday, November 7, 2026

Start: 6:00 PM | End: 7:00 PM

The Grand Hall

1 Main St, Houston, TX 77002

Black attire.

View the full details and respond here: https://app.example.test/gig/token-1

Thanks,
Example Strings

Example Strings Musician Guidelines

As a Example Strings musician, your professionalism reflects directly on the group. These expectations apply from arrival to departure at every event.

Cancellation Policy

If you need to cancel after accepting this engagement, you are responsible for finding your own qualified substitute, subject to our approval. Please notify us as soon as possible if any conflicts arise so we can work together to find a solution.

1. Professionalism

Always assume you're being watched and recorded. Stay positive and professional at all times. Keep conversation minimal and appropriate.

2. Phones

Keep phones silenced and out of sight unless used for tuning or essential cues.

3. Appearance & Punctuality

Arrive early with buffer time. Dress professionally and in accordance with Example Strings attire guidelines.

4. Belongings & Case Safety

Bring only your instrument, music, stand, and water. No large purses or bags (small black purses are okay). All instrument cases must be out of sight and out of the way.

5. Overtime

You will be compensated for all time played beyond the contracted hours. If asked to stay past the contracted period, only agree to do so if you are available. The lead musician must confirm approval with the client or event coordinator before continuing beyond the contracted time.

6. Team Conduct

Greet teammates professionally. Be warm, collaborative, and supportive.

This email was sent by Example Strings via Podium.

If you have questions, please contact the organization directly.
